verdict.rationale: Claude's own help docs say individual users can export their user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy, and that exports include conversation data and account user data, which covers the story's core. Enterprise also documents a Compliance API for programmatic access to chat histories. Missing for 10: details on export format and delivery and on whether the export is truly complete (e.g., files, projects, memory), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can export my complete chat history and account data

citations.quote: Individual Claude users can export user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy
Data exports include conversation data and the user data for your account.
Compliance API: programmatically access Claude usage data including activity logs, chat histories, and file content
